At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We're looking for a senior to staff level product manager to join the team.

In this role, you'll be responsible for leading the development of products end-to-end, from conception through development and rollout. If you're excited to have a lot of ownership while remaining in the details day to day, this might be a great fit for you.

Linear is a product-led company that focuses on both building and selling. It's up to you to bring together the building and selling sides of the company in order to create something that our customers will love.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America or Europe time zones. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Perform up-front discovery through user interviews, competitive research, data analysis, etc. and present findings to the team with conviction and rigor

 - Help engineers and designers deeply understand user needs, empowering them to make great product decisions

 - Craft messaging around upcoming features that resonates with users

 - Enable sales and marketing teams to effectively communicate with and win with customers

What we’re looking for

 - 6+ years experience in the software industry

 - Previous experience in engineering and/or design roles

 - Exceptional product and operational judgement

 - World-class design & product taste

 - Shameless curiosity, a propensity to question things deeply

 - Extreme speed and clarity

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

Investment Associate (Experienced) 
 reposted 3/13/26 
 Innovation Works | Pittsburgh, PA 
 About Innovation Works 
 Innovation Works (IW) is one of the nation’s most active early-stage investors and a key driver of the Pittsburgh region’s startup ecosystem. Through direct investments, venture funds, and strategic support, IW helps launch and scale high-growth technology companies. IW also manages Riverfront Ventures (RFV), a venture capital fund focused on supporting promising startups and accelerating regional innovation. 
 The Role 
 Innovation Works is seeking a mid-level Investment Associate to support the firm’s investment activities across its early-stage portfolio and venture fund operations. This role is ideal for a highly analytical professional who is passionate about startups, venture investing, and emerging technologies. 
 The Investment Associate works closely with the CEO and Senior Investment Associate to evaluate new investment opportunities, manage portfolio data and reporting, coordinate diligence processes, and support investor engagement. The role offers broad exposure to venture investing and the opportunity to work with founders, investors, and ecosystem partners shaping the future of the Pittsburgh technology economy. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Deal Flow & Investment Diligence 
 • Conduct market research, competitive landscape analysis, and preliminary investment evaluation. 
• Support diligence processes, including document review, reference calls, and financial analysis. 
• Prepare internal investment summaries and materials for Investment Committee discussions. 
• Participate in founder meetings and assist in follow-up diligence and analysis. 
 Portfolio Operations & Reporting 
 • Maintain accurate portfolio and investment data in Salesforce. 
• Track follow-on investment activity and company performance metrics. 
• Support quarterly reporting processes for Riverfront Ventures. 
• Assist with annual portfolio valuations in coordination with external auditors. 
 Investment Operations 
 • Prepare materials and documentation for Investment Committee meetings. 
• Take meeting minutes and ensure proper documentation and follow-up. 
• Coordinate scheduling of founder presentations and diligence discussions. 
 Investor Relations & Ecosystem Engagement 
 • Maintain investor CRM records and support outreach to potential co-investors. 
• Assist in preparing materials for investor meetings and ecosystem engagements. 
• Coordinate logistics for investor events and venture ecosystem programming. 
 Data & Market Research 
 • Conduct market research and sector analysis to support investment evaluation. 
• Assist with the preparation of IW’s annual Investment Landscape Report. 
• Maintain datasets related to regional venture financing activity and portfolio performance. 
 Qualifications 
 • 3–5 years of experience in venture capital, investment banking, private equity, consulting, finance, or other analytical roles. 
• Strong analytical and financial modeling skills; advanced Excel proficiency preferred. 
• Experience working with startups or early-stage companies strongly preferred. 
• Familiarity with venture capital financing structures and startup ecosystems. 
• Experience with CRM systems such as Salesforce is a plus. 
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 What We’re Looking For 
 • Strong intellectual curiosity about technology, startups, and venture investing. 
• Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail. 
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
• Proactive, self-directed work style with strong ownership of projects. 
• Collaborative mindset and high level of personal integrity. 
 Why Join Innovation Works 
 This role provides a unique opportunity to work at the center of one of the country’s most dynamic regional innovation ecosystems. The Investment Associate will gain hands-on exposure to venture investing, support the growth of breakthrough startups, and contribute to the continued development of Pittsburgh as a national technology hub. 
 Equal Opportunity Employer 
 Innovation Works, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a respectful and welcoming workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

About Alumni Ventures 

 Alumni Ventures is one of the world’s most active venture capital platforms, with $1.4B+ in assets raised and investments in 1,600+ companies. Our network of 850,000+ members and 40+ dedicated investors connects accredited individuals to high-quality venture deals—typically reserved for institutions—through our alumni-driven communities and diversified co-investment strategy. With offices in Boston, New York, Chicago, Menlo Park, Manchester, NH, London and Tokyo we’re rapidly growing and committed to fueling entrepreneurial success while developing the next generation of VC professionals. 

 We believe our best work happens when we’re together. AV operates as a 5-day-a-week, in-office culture because collaboration, mentorship, and shared momentum matter. 

 About This Role 

 As an Investor Relations Associate at Alumni Ventures, you'll play a vital role in supporting our investor community while gaining hands-on exposure to venture capital, startup investing, investor relations, and fund operations. 

 This role sits at the intersection of customer success, relationship management, investor communications, and financial services. You'll work closely with prospective and existing investors, Managing Partners, Community Managers, and cross-functional teams to support fundraising initiatives, investor engagement activities, and operational processes. 

 You'll help individuals navigate their journey with Alumni Ventures—from initial interest through investment and ongoing engagement—while developing expertise in client service, investor relations, venture capital, and business operations. 

 This is an ideal opportunity for professionals who are eager to learn, take ownership, and grow their careers in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. Through hands-on training, mentorship, and direct exposure to senior leadership, you'll build valuable skills in communication, relationship management, project management, operations, and venture investing. 

 While prior venture capital experience is not required, successful candidates are often interested in investing, entrepreneurship, startups, financial markets, or business strategy and are excited to learn about the venture capital ecosystem. 

 What You'll Do 

 Investor & Community Support 

• Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for prospective and existing investors. 

• Respond to investor questions through email, phone, webinars, events, and other communication channels. 

• Provide timely, accurate, and thoughtful support using approved resources and internal playbooks. 

• Help individuals navigate Alumni Ventures' offerings, processes, and community experience. 

 Investor Support and Community Operations 

• Build strong relationships with investors, community members, and internal stakeholders. 

• Deliver a high-touch, service-oriented customer experience across the investor journey. 

• Anticipate needs, identify issues, and help resolve questions with professionalism and empathy. 

• Support investor onboarding and ongoing engagement efforts. 

 Partner Support & Operations 

• Collaborate closely with Managing Partners, Community Managers, and senior leaders. 

• Support fundraising initiatives, fund operations, club programs, and syndication activities. 

• Assist with virtual events, investor meetings, webinar preparation, and follow-up activities. 

• Help ensure smooth execution of key investor engagement and operational processes. 

 Data, Reporting & Process Improvement 

• Track engagement activity, investor interactions, and key business metrics. 

• Help maintain clean and accurate data in HubSpot and other internal systems. 

• Support reporting for Community Managers, Partners, and leadership. 

• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, communication, and the overall investor experience. 

 Strategic Projects 

• Participate in special projects and cross-functional initiatives. 

• Support research, process improvements, pilot programs, and team priorities. 

• Take on increasing ownership as your knowledge and experience grow. 

 Who You Are 

 We're looking for a client-centered, detail-oriented professional who is excited to grow in a collaborative, team-oriented environment. 

 Required Qualifications 

• 1+ years of experience in customer success, client services, relationship management, account management, hospitality, recruiting, operations, financial services, consulting, or another customer-facing environment. 

• Effective written and verbal communication skills. 

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through consistently. 

• Demonstrated ability to build positive relationships and provide thoughtful support to customers, or other stakeholders. 

• Ability to learn and effectively use new systems, tools, and business processes. 

• Interest in learning about investing, venture capital, financial markets, startups, or related business topics. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

• Experience using HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms. 

• Experience supporting clients, customers, members, investors, advisors, or other external stakeholders. 

• Exposure to financial services, investing, venture capital, wealth management, banking, consulting, or related industries. 

• Experience coordinating projects, events, webinars, or operational workflows. 

 A Note to Candidates 

 We recognize that talent comes from many backgrounds. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you'd be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply—even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed above. 

 Our Culture & How We Work at AV 
 Regardless of title, this is what great looks like at AV. 

• Put team and stakeholders first. We win together and measure success by the value we create for our investors, founders, and each other. 

• Take extreme ownership and bias toward action. We act like owners, move with urgency, and follow through. 

• Debate rigorously and commit fully. We welcome diverse views, use data and sound judgment, and once aligned, execute as one team. 

• Focus on what matters most. We prioritize impact, simplify where possible, and channel energy where we have a real advantage. 

• Be AI-forward and tech-optimistic. We actively use AI and emerging technologies to work smarter, make better decisions, and amplify human judgment — not replace it. 

• Stay curious and think big.  We are continuous learners, aim high and build for long-term impact. 

 Benefits & Perks 
 We offer a flexible, employee-first benefits program designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work. Benefits begin shortly after hire and are designed to give you choice and flexibility based on your needs. 

• Comprehensive health coverage with multiple plan options, including employer-funded deductible support and HSA contributions 

• Dental and vision plans with multiple coverage tiers 

• Tax-advantaged accounts including HSA, FSA, and commuter benefits (with monthly employer contribution) 

• 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting 

• Company-paid life and disability insurance , plus optional supplemental coverage 

• Additional support programs including EAP, health advocacy, and wellness resources 

• Flexible, unlimited PTO and generous paid parental leave 

• 11 company holidays 

 Compensation 

 Compensation includes base salary plus equity and corporate bonus. 
 Privacy Policy   

 All employment is subject to passing a background check. Alumni Ventures is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.
